# @ic-reactor/vite-plugin — AI Quick Guide

Vite integration for automatic IC Reactor generation from `.did` files.

## Install

```bash
pnpm add -D @ic-reactor/vite-plugin
pnpm add @ic-reactor/react @tanstack/react-query @icp-sdk/core
```

## Minimal Setup

```ts
import { icReactor } from "@ic-reactor/vite-plugin"

icReactor({
  canisters: [{ name: "backend", didFile: "./backend/backend.did" }],
})
```

## Behavior

- Runs codegen on startup and `.did` changes
- Regenerates declarations + `index.generated.ts`
- Preserves user-facing `index.ts` wrapper after initial creation
- Relative paths (`didFile`, `outDir`) resolve against Vite's `config.root`
- Each entry needs its own output directory: a later entry with the same
  `name` and `outDir` as an earlier one fails, with the CLI's error
- A failed canister fails `vite build`; in `vite dev` it goes to the terminal
  and the browser error overlay instead

## Key Options

- Plugin level: `canisters`, `outDir`, `clientManagerPath`, `target`,
  `injectEnvironment`, `failOnError`
- Per canister (inside `canisters[]`): `name`, `didFile`, `outDir`,
  `clientManagerPath`, `target`, `mode`, `canisterId`
- `injectEnvironment` for local `ic_env` cookie + `/api` proxy behavior in
  `vite dev` and `vite preview`. While `icp` reports no network or a
  configured canister has no ID, each page load asks `icp` again, so deploying
  after `vite dev` started needs only a reload; once every configured canister
  resolves, page loads run no `icp` command and a redeploy into a fresh
  network needs a restart. `/api` follows the detected network. The
  consumer side is a positive allowlist: `ClientManager` trusts the cookie — its
  root key, its Internet Identity provider, and the canister IDs a reactor
  resolves by name — only for loopback, `localhost`, and dev-container hosts.
  Serving a dev build over a tunnel or custom domain needs
  `allowEnvConfig: true` (formerly `allowEnvRootKey`); without it a generated
  reactor that carries no `canisterId` throws instead of reading one from the
  cookie — see `packages/core/llms.txt`
- `failOnError` overrides the default (`true` for build, `false` for dev)

## Best Practices

- Keep custom code in stable wrapper/factory modules
- Do not hand-edit generated `index.generated.ts`

- Full AI guide: https://ic-reactor.b3pay.net/llms-full.txt
- Vite plugin docs: https://ic-reactor.b3pay.net/v3/packages/vite-plugin
